gates.question: family_compatibility
gates.threshold: the case must be in the registered library

gates.question: numerical_health
gates.threshold: the solver must complete without a fatal error
gates.detail: the archived run completed to its requested end time and reported no numerical failure

gates.question: convergence
gates.threshold: drift over the window <= 0.02 of the mean streamwise force
gates.detail: the drag looks converged -- this is exactly why watching only the drag would have accepted the run

gates.question: stationarity
gates.detail: a periodic lateral mode is still growing across the assessment window, so the flow is not developed

gates.question: validation
gates.threshold: a reference comparison requires a stationary flow first
gates.detail: validation was never attempted: a run that is still developing cannot be compared against a reference

gates.question: permitted_actions
gates.threshold: a proposed action must be in the family's registered vocabulary
gates.detail: an action outside the vocabulary is refused, not executed

content.prompt: run the registered cube case drifting_wake
content.confidence_note: matched on ['cube'] | family supplied explicitly by the caller
content.note: an interpretation is a PROPOSAL; family compatibility and geometry admissibility are decided by deterministic code

llm_proposals.content: STILL_DEVELOPING: While the streamwise (fx) and vertical (fy) force components appear stabilized in the latter half of the simulation, the spanwise force (fz) exhibits growing fluctuations and increasing half-cycle extrema amplitudes all the way to the end of the record (t = 79.98). This indicates that the 3-D shedding and recirculation structures have not reached full statistical stationarity across all force components.

NUMERICALLY_UNHEALTHY: Although the streamwise force fx and vertical force fy appear to reach a steady mean, the lateral force fz exhibits an unbounded, escalating oscillation amplitude over time. This systematic growth in lateral force fluctuations indicates a numerical instability or unphysical feedback loop in the spanwise direction, requiring a safe stop.

STILL_DEVELOPING: Although streamwise and vertical force components (fx and fy) appear largely stable in the later time windows, the lateral force component (fz) exhibits growing fluctuation amplitude and standard deviation up to the final recorded window (t = 70 to 80). This indicates that the 3-D wake structures are still developing and have not reached a statistically stationary state across all components.

rule: the verdict is computed from the gates alone; a model proposal is recorded but never binding
